title: epistel captions dataset
description: The editorial captions layer over the image manifest (context/captions.json in the export, copied verbatim from data/context/captions.json) — one entry per manifest image id, holding an alt text, a nullable Maria Notabene caption, a nullable photo credit, the entry's source lines and the drafter's recorded doubts. The rounds' repair logs are development history and live in the repository's audit trail, not here. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; see docs/captions-method.md.

id.description: The image id from export/images.json — the join key.

caption.description: null is a decision, not a gap: the edition refers to this file nowhere, so there is no letter for the caption to speak from — the entry's note says so.
